information: **ST JUDES RESEARCH HOSPITAL** We will be giving a portion of the proceeds from registration fees to St Judes Research Hospital - we will also be having a Cube Raffle (more info later on the cubes) and all proceeds will also go to St Judes Research Hospital. You can also make a direct donation at the competition. **MEET & GREET** We will be hosting a meet and greet on Friday March 15 from 730pm - 930pm EST at the venue. Come and see the venue, socialize with fellow cubers and meet your new Florida Delegate. **STAFF** Please contact us if you are interested.
